scenario: 401 with a clear cause: draft reply with sources
subject: 401 Unauthorized on every call since this morning
body:
Hi,

our invoice sync started failing around 09:10 UTC today. Every call to GET /v1/invoices now returns 401 and the response body says error.code = token_expired. Our worker fetches an access token once when it starts and has been running for several hours. Example request ID: req_7Hq2LmX9.

What should we change on our side?

Dana Ostrova, Northwind Ledger (synthetic)

scenario: Ambiguous report: ask for specific missing details
subject: Our integration doesn't work anymore
body:

scenario: Recorded output cites a section that was not given to the model: validator rejects it
subject: 429 Too Many Requests during nightly import
body:
Our nightly import sends about 300 requests per second to POST /v1/invoices and we start getting 429 Too Many Requests after a minute. Our client retries immediately. How should we handle this?

Jonas Weber, Alpine Billing (synthetic)

scenario: First model call times out; retry succeeds
subject: Webhook events not arriving at our endpoint
body:
We stopped receiving invoice.paid webhook events at https://hooks.tidepool.example/fernwick since about 14:00 UTC. Example event: evt_3kP0aZ81. Our endpoint looks up the invoice in our database before it responds, which can take 15-20 seconds. Can you tell us why deliveries fail?

Aiko Tanaka, Tidepool Apps (synthetic)

scenario: 403 insufficient scope: draft reply, distinct from 401
subject: 403 Forbidden when creating invoices
body:
Reading invoices works fine, but POST /v1/invoices returns 403 with error.code insufficient_scope and required_scope invoices:write. We refreshed the token and it did not help. Request ID req_Zr81Qw.

Tom Novak, Kestrel Freight (synthetic)
